clockSemantics: readyToWheel/loadToWheel values timestamp CDP dispatch, not event arrival. Actual trusted wheel/scroll UTC and performance remain separately recorded.

sharedCoordinateAudit.method: Read-only comparison of actual preserved DOM text to unchanged shared segments of actual cached body; original records retained.
sharedCoordinateAudit.originalTrimmedLookupLimitation: Trimmed text lookup includes a four-character leading-space offset. Canonical segment start is the saved shared coordinate; original false exact-offset flag is not an application fault.

bottomInterpretation: Saved 0.9999 was created by real native previous-chapter navigation. Visible segment 28 at real scrollTop=max2933 is viewport clamping, not a reason to overwrite the character sentinel.
projectionNote: Repeated cumulative scroll event histories trimmed to latest two per observation; full preserved histories remain private. Load, dispatch, actual trusted input and saved coordinate fields retained.
